items.title: generateProductCsvStep
items.description:
This step generates a CSV file that exports products. The CSV
file is created and stored using the registered [File Module Provider](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/file).

items.title: normalizeCsvToChunksStep
items.description:
This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the chunks
to be processed. Each chunk is written to a file using the file provider.

items.title: normalizeCsvStep

This step parses a CSV file holding products to import, returning the products as
objects that can be imported.

objects that can be imported.

items.title: processProductOptionsForImportStep
items.description:
This step processes products with options during import. It performs the following actions:

1. Creates product options.
2. Transforms `product.options` in the input to `product.option_ids`.
3. Transforms variant options from `{title: value}` to `{optionId: value}`.

items.title: waitConfirmationProductImportStep
items.description:
This step waits until a product import is confirmed. It's useful before executing the
[batchProductsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/batchProductsWorkflow).

This step is asynchronous and will make the workflow using it a [Long-Running Workflow](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/long-running-workflow).
